label: L-01
title: The shortfall top-up mints phUSD directly against FlaxToken, bypassing PhusdStableMinter's rolling 24h maxMintPerDay AND its stablecoin collateral deposit
description: _phUSD().mint(address(this), phUSDMinted) at :646 is gated only by canMint + mintVersion (phUSDMintAvailable) -- no cap, no allowance, no collateral. The route, not the value, decides the outcome.
impact: SCOPED TO THE BYPASS (anti-double-count). A solvency control that cannot see this path: zero collateral is taken, mintedToday is not incremented, and the rolling 24h cap is not consulted. For LEAK MAGNITUDE see M-01 / ss18m1 -- the 6.5425-USDe-class figure is stated ONCE, in M-01, and is deliberately NOT restated here.
severityBasis: C4 MEDIUM. The severity-classifier's downgrade to Low was OVERTURNED by the severity-auditor on 2026-09-01 and adjudicated ACCEPTED by the coordinator. A structural mint-control bypass: assets are not directly stolen, but a solvency control (PhusdStableMinter's rolling 24h maxMintPerDay AND its collateral deposit) cannot see this path at all. See `severityChange`. THIS IS THE CONTESTED CALL OF RUN 18.
evidence: _phUSD().mint(address(this), phUSDMinted) at :646 is gated only by canMint + mintVersion (phUSDMintAvailable): no cap, no allowance, no collateral.

PoC: cap armed at 10e18 -- a direct mint of 11e18 reverts 'Daily mint limit exceeded' -- yet autoAnnihilate issues 90e18 in one tx with zero collateral, and the minter's mintedToday records only 5e18.
Sharpest control: an identical 100e18 payout routed frictionlessly THROUGH the minter is refused by the cap. Same value, same beneficiary, opposite outcome -- the difference is purely the route.
recommendation: Route the top-up through PhusdStableMinter, or cap it independently.
knownIssueRuling: NOT SUPPRESSED. N28's authority is LIMITED and expressly excludes '(a) whether the freshly minted phUSD is backed ... (b) the size or unboundedness of the inflation'. This finding is precisely (a) and (b). N27 documents that V2 can mint phUSD; it does not document that the mint escapes the minter's controls.
crossRefs: M-01 / ss18m1 -- CROSS-REFERENCE ONLY, DO NOT COLLAPSE. This entry is WHY THE LEAK HAS NO CEILING; M-01 is who can trigger it. Distinct root causes, independent mitigations (route/cap the top-up vs. bound and report slippageToleranceBps).

severityChange.basisVerbatim: The original Medium->Low downgrade rested on avoiding double-counting the slippageToleranceBps conditional with M-01. That reasoning is wrong because THE PRECONDITIONS DIFFER. M-01's 142bps breakeven gates THIRD-PARTY ATTACKER PROFITABILITY at that block with those pools. L-01 fires on ANY shortfall from ANY source -- ordinary honest AMM slippage, the N20-blessed self-sandwich, and per N33 a zero-delivery strategy producing a 100%-inflation-funded payout. L-01's precondition is STRICTLY WEAKER than M-01's; pricing the weaker precondition lower because the stronger is priced at Medium is backwards.
severityChange.sizeIsNotThePoint: The 90e18-vs-10e18-cap figure is a demonstration of STRUCTURAL BLINDNESS, not a claim that 9000bps is required. A 1.1x-cap breach is the same hole as a 9x breach. The size-independent evidence is the control: an identical 100e18 payout routed frictionlessly THROUGH the minter is REFUSED by the cap -- same value, same beneficiary, opposite outcome; the difference is purely the route.
severityChange.mitigationsAreDisjoint: THE TEST FOR WHETHER TWO FINDINGS ARE ONE. M-01 = read/bound/report slippageToleranceBps from the StableStaker side. L-01 = route the top-up through PhusdStableMinter or cap it locally. NEITHER DISCHARGES THE OTHER. DO NOT COLLAPSE L-01 INTO M-01.
severityChange.knownIssueRulingN28: This run's sanitizer rule 6 states N28 does NOT cover backing or unboundedness -- it authorises the mechanism and rounding direction only. L-01 is exactly backing and unboundedness. NOT SUPPRESSED.
severityChange.antiDoubleCountRequirement: SCOPE L-01's IMPACT TO THE BYPASS: a solvency control that cannot see this path; zero collateral taken; mintedToday not incremented. L-01 must CITE M-01 for leak magnitude rather than restate it. The 6.5425-USDe-class figure is stated ONCE, in M-01. Any report writer touching these two must preserve this split.
